source_reference.scope: Authors’ 4.51 format source used by design; the executable fixture producer is pinned separately at 4.50

oracle: Every file written and read back byte-for-byte through original MyDOS CIO. Expected bytes/lengths are the producer jobs; host extraction independently agrees.

profile.scope: Queued SIO tests; drive-specific headless MOUNT fixed without changing CPU/peripheral emulation

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

profile.write_delay_basis: Figure 18 (1.0–1.8 ms); qualified only against these pinned disk models. Page 219 prose says 10–18 ms and is not used for these profiles.
profile.timeout_policy: One 250-tick active watchdog: ACK, result and data all inherit its remaining time; receiving a byte does not restart it. No separate phase or per-byte timeout in this disposable probe.

fault_responder.scope: Explicit D8 protocol/stop-bit corruption, test-only environment selector; POKEY and guest execute normally. Includes passive observer and drive-specific MOUNT patches.
